newsitem.title: USA: Trident Rowan files stock, warrant offer.
newsitem.headline: Trident Rowan files stock, warrant offer.

text.p: Trident Rowan Group Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission Wednesday for an offering of 1.25 million shares of common and 1.25 million common stock purchase warrants.
Each warrant is exercisable for four years starting next year at 120 percent of the offering price of the company's common stock, it said.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for working capital and for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Underwriter GKN Securities will have a 30-day over-allotment option on to 187,500 shares and/or 187,500 warrants, the company said.
